name: Wheat Farming Simulator
desc:
🌾Anyone can become a wheat farmer in Wheat Farming Simulator - run through lush wheat fields, upgrade your harvesting tool, discover and tame pets, and become the richest farmer ever!

👍 Codes: "PETS", "TAMING", "MEGAREBIRTH", "LAVABEAST", "TAMEPETS"

All platforms are supported 🎮

The game is new so there may be a few bugs. Please report them when you find them so the game can be improved, thanks!

shutdown = update/bugfix
